Actor.Name: Actor
Actor.Summary: A logical grouping of datamodel nodes which can enable scripts to run in parallel.

ForceLimitMode.Name: ForceLimitMode
ForceLimitMode.Summary: Selects the mode for force limit. Options Uniform or Per-component

Mode.Name: Mode
Mode.Summary: Selects the mode of the velocity constraint.  Options Line, Plane, Vector

LineDirection.Name: LineDirection
LineDirection.Summary: Direction of the line used to contraint the velocity to a line.

LineVelocity.Name: LineVelocity
LineVelocity.Summary: The value of the constraint velocity along a line.

PlanePrimaryTangent.Name: PlanePrimaryTangent
PlanePrimaryTangent.Summary: The primary axis in the plane.

PlaneSecondaryTangent.Name: PlaneSecondaryTangent
PlaneSecondaryTangent.Summary: The secondary axis in the plane.

PlaneVelocity.Name: PlaneVelocity
PlaneVelocity.Summary: Velocity coefficients in the constraint plane.

Velocity.Name: Velocity
Velocity.Summary: Constraint velocity for the Vector mode.

MaxForce.Name: MaxForce
MaxForce.Summary: Maximum force magnitude that is applied to satisfy the constraint.

RelativeTo.Name: RelativeTo
RelativeTo.Summary: Selects whether the velocity orientation is relative to attachment0, attachment1 or the world.

Show Plugin GUI Service in Explorer.Name: Show Plugin GUI Service in Explorer

GetMoveVelocity.Name: GetMoveVelocity
GetMoveVelocity.Description: Returns the movement velocity based on the player input.

PrimaryPart.Name: PrimaryPart
PrimaryPart.Description: A Part that serves as a physical reference for the Model's Pivot. If set, the Pivot will follow the PrimaryPart during simulation, otherwise the Pivot will be a fixed world space location.

EvaluationThrottled.Name: EvaluationThrottled
EvaluationThrottled.Description: Returns true if animation evaluation for the Animator is throttled.

Type.Name: Type
Type.Description: Specifies how the solver satisfies this control.

EndEffector.Name: EndEffector
EndEffector.Description: The part that you are interested in moving to reach the Target.

Target.Name: Target
Target.Description: The object that the EndEffector reaches for or points at.

ChainRoot.Name: ChainRoot
ChainRoot.Description: The last part that you are interested in moving your character.

Offset.Name: Offset
Offset.Description: An additional offset applied on top of the Target in its local space.

Enabled.Name: Enabled
Enabled.Description: Toggles the control on and off.

Weight.Name: Weight
Weight.Description: Specifies how much this IK control should affect the final pose.

Priority.Name: Priority
Priority.Description: Specifies the order in which controls are solved.

SmoothTime.Name: SmoothTime
SmoothTime.Description: Specifies the time in seconds to smooth the control by.

GetChainLength.Name: GetChainLength
GetChainLength.Description: Returns the total length of the chain, which is the sum of the lengths of its segments.

GetChainCount.Name: GetChainCount
GetChainCount.Description: Returns the number of segments in the chain, which is one less than the number of nodes.

GetNodeWorldCFrame.Name: GetNodeWorldCFrame
GetNodeWorldCFrame.Description: Returns the CFrame of the node with the given index in world space.

GetNodeLocalCFrame.Name: GetNodeLocalCFrame
GetNodeLocalCFrame.Description: Returns the CFrame of the node with the given index in local space.

GetRawFinalTarget.Name: GetRawFinalTarget
GetRawFinalTarget.Description: Returns the CFrame of the raw final target in world space.

GetSmoothedFinalTarget.Name: GetSmoothedFinalTarget
GetSmoothedFinalTarget.Description: Returns the CFrame of the smoothed final target in world space.
